title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions on Israeli sport, from a Wassaw Sound windsurfing bronze to a Belgrade upset thirty years later.

questions.question: What medal did Gal Fridman win in windsurfing at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics?
questions.explanation: Fridman took bronze in the Men's Mistral One Design class off Savannah, Israel's only medal of the 1996 Games, before winning gold in the same class at Athens 2004.

questions.question: By what aggregate score did Hapoel Beer Sheva eliminate Red Star Belgrade from Champions League qualifying?
questions.explanation: Beer Sheva won 1-0 away in the first leg and 2-0 at home in the second, a 3-0 aggregate that prompted Red Star's board to move to sack Dejan Stanković.

questions.question: Ariel Berkovich, grandson of Israeli basketball legend Miki Berkovich, was just promoted to the senior squad of which club?
questions.explanation: The 17-year-old point guard was promoted to Maccabi Ironi Ramat Gan's senior squad while simultaneously registered with Hapoel Gezer/Naan under the double-roster rule.

questions.question: Which Premier League club agreed a fee with Union Saint-Gilloise for Israel international Anan Khalaili?
questions.explanation: Crystal Palace agreed a fee of roughly £21m, beating out Everton, Aston Villa and Newcastle to sign Khalaili, who would become the most expensive Israeli player in history.

questions.question: At the 2008 Chess Olympiad in Dresden, which nation finished one point ahead of Israel's silver-medal team to take gold?
questions.explanation: Israel's open team took silver with 18 match points, one behind gold medallists Armenia on 19 — the first team medal in the history of Israel's senior open squad.
